entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • API Compat reports CP0008 false positive for internal interfaces from friend assemblies #54451
  • GenAPI omits notnull generic constraints from generated reference source #54450
  • Trace 'user sessions' in a first-class manner across GHA and AzDo #54446
  • Blazor compilation now longer completes. It just fills all available memory and goes into memory thrashing. #54441

Closed

  • SDK 10.0.203 not available in any Ubuntu packages repository #54262
    Discussion
  • [Deduplicate SDK Files] Utilize Windows tarballs in GitHub Actions setup-dotnet #52212
  • add the `--no-dependencies` option to `dotnet test` when running MSbuild-based tests #50640
  • [MTP] Cannot switch off terminal logger when building during dotnet test #52229
  • dotnet test command definition fails if global.json is unreadable #52384
